notes: Strong T1 Jailbreak (4 points), but no economy afterward: T3 and T6 were four clicks each for credits, and Carmen (T4) was never used. On T8 the Runner ran into the known Piranhas twice more and on T10 once more, though it could not break it and the ETR condition held; this lost The Back, Daily Casts, Debbie, Concerto and Laser Pointer to net damage. The Runner sat on 6 points from T5 and never pressured the scoring remote again.

T1 put Hybrid Release in a naked remote and T2 spent all money on Neurospike for 1 damage, dropping to 0 credits. After that the Corp built sensible one-ice remotes and scored Yagi-Uda (T9), Sericulture (T11) and Yagi-Uda (T15) against a passive Runner, but the pace was slow and it left many naked junk remotes.

The Runner made 3 extra HQ runs on T1 that kept seeing Government Subsidy, then from T4 to T26 did almost nothing but click for credits up to 96 while holding 5 cards. It never installed a breaker. It let the Corp score Above the Law (T16) and three Divested Trusts (T20, T24, T27) out of remotes it never contested. It facechecked Akhet (T8) and Tree Line (T15) with no breakers. There was no coherent plan.

The Hagen remote and the later Ansel 1.0 server scored well (Ingatan T2, Megaprix T4, Meliès T13, ADT T15). R&D had no ice until T3, and that ice stayed unrezzed through T10 while the Runner ran R&D four times a turn. Even with 12-13 credits on T8-T9 the Corp never rezzed it, so Megaprix, ADT and Ingatan were stolen. Credits sat at 0-3 from T4 to T7.

Solid aggressive Sable play: it stole Tomorrow's Headline, Witch Hunt and Tomorrow's Headline, then won with Freedom of Information on T11. Window of Opportunity was played twice (T3, T7) just for Archives runs with nothing to derez, and T1 spent down to 0 credits. Carrying several tags was risky but not punished.

The Corp stacked four ice on an empty Server 1 (T1-T5) but never installed an agenda there. It also never rezzed its HQ or R&D ice, though it had 5-9 credits. The Runner walked into HQ for ADT (T2) and Megaprix+ADT (T5). T3 was three credit clicks while holding agendas in an open HQ.

An efficient multi-access game: it took Next Big Thing T1, used Self-modifying Code to fetch Gauss for Capacitor, and stole two Oracle Thinktanks and Remastered Edition by T7. T4 ended at 0 credits with several tags, which was a gamble, but the Corp could not punish it.

The Runner never installed a breaker, clicked for credits up to 55 (T2-T4, T9, T11, T15-T19) and only facechecked remotes with nothing to break them: Hammer/Envelopment T5, Akhet T10, Tree Line T13 and Descent T20. Corp sat at 0-2 credits on T6-T9 and T14-T15 while advancing Above the Law, two Transport Monopolies and Divested Trust, yet the Runner contested none of them.

On T5 the Corp installed and advanced Lotus Haze in the just-raided Server 2 with 1 credit left, so it could not rez the second ice, and Lotus Haze was stolen at once. From T6 on the economy collapsed to clicking for credits. The HQ ice was never rezzed all game, so Hybrid Release was stolen from HQ on T12. R&D gave up Lotus Haze and Longevity Serum on T13.

The Hafrún remote scored See How They Run, Sisyphus Protocol and Hybrid Release, and Bladderwort net damage set up the T10 flatline. R&D had no ice until T6 and HQ never had any, so Hybrid Release and Regenesis were lost on T1 and See How They Run on T9. Credits stayed near 0 all game, though sabotage partly forced this.

Server 1 never had an end-the-run ice that worked (Ping, VSA and Tsarevna do not stop the run). On T9 the Corp spent its money rezzing HQ ice during Burner and left Tomorrow's Headline in the remote with its new ice unrezzed, and it was stolen. On T11 it installed and advanced Next Big Thing in that same non-ETR server with 1 credit left while the Runner sat at 4 points with 16 credits, which lost the game.

With no breakers it facechecked HQ and R&D on T1 and Server 1 on T3, losing credits to Afshar. It then made repeated Banner-assisted HQ runs while Above the Law scored twice from the remote, and Leech counters were never used. On T7 it saw Measured Response in HQ and still ended the turn at 2 credits after a successful run, which let the Corp flatline it on T8.

With 13-17 credits on T2-T4 the Corp only drew and played economy cards, installing no agendas or extra ice. From T5 to T9 it spent about eight clicks and 16 credits repeatedly trashing Daily Casts, which drove itself to 0-2 credits. Meanwhile HQ held Tomorrow's Headline x2, Next Big Thing x2 and Embedded Reporting behind one ice, and three of them were stolen.

Reasonable rig and economy early, with a good Regenesis steal on T5. On T8 against Jinteki it took 2 net damage from Urtica Cipher, then Jailbreaked into unrezzed R&D ice with a 2-card grip. Anemone and the Fujii Asset Retrieval steal then flatlined it, a foreseeable risk. T1 also spent down to 0 credits.

Good Archives awareness: it took Fujii from Archives on T2 and Hybrid Release from Archives on T7 to win. The main waste was T6, using Tread Lightly on Server 2 into the known Tatu-Bola with no barrier breaker installed.

The Corp put three ice on Server 1 (T4) to protect only Otto Campaign. Then on T7-T9 it sat on 18-27 credits, clicking for credits and discarding, while the Runner ran R&D every turn past a single Vertigo. It never added ice to R&D or HQ, so Project Ingatan (T9) and ADT (T12) were stolen from R&D.

It got through the Ballista remote twice (Transport Monopoly T7, SDS T10). Afterward it sat on 18-27 credits from T11 to T16, drawing, installing economy pieces and running an empty Archives (T11, T13), without contesting Server 1. Meanwhile the Corp rescored SDS (T12) and scored Divested Trust on T15 and T17 to win.

On T2 the Corp put Sericulture Expansion behind Diviner and Vicsek, neither of which stopped the run, and it was stolen at once. Credits then fell to 1-4 (T3 spent two clicks drawing instead). HQ ice was never rezzed and Vicsek trashed itself off R&D, so Hybrid Release, Yagi-Uda and Fujii were taken from open centrals by T5.

A coherent plan: Ansel 1.0 servers locked out the breakerless Runner and scored Meliès (T7) and two Megaprix (T13, T16). R&D's second ice went unrezzed until T10 despite 10 credits on T5, which leaked Megaprix and Superconducting Hub. T2 and T4 were all credit clicks.

Good early R&D pressure took Artificial Cryptocrash and Next Big Thing for 5 points. After that it ran R&D seven more times through Funhouse on T5-T6, taking a tag each run and going broke. From T7 to T16 it only clicked for credits and paid 2 credits per tag removal, while the Corp scored Cryptocrash, Remastered Edition and Oracle Thinktank from Server 3. It held the same 3 cards the whole game and never drew, built or pressured the remote again.
